note: origin = path of the source file in the original run tree (prefix ${MEDVQA_ROOT}), with the same directory/file renaming applied as in this repository; sha256_original = sha256 of that file there; modified_from_original = the file was edited mechanically (paths -> ${MEDVQA_ROOT}, internal identifiers -> descriptive English names, provenance paths reduced, template text -> template id), with comments, docstrings, messages and free-text notes translated from Portuguese to English, internal document references removed and dashes replaced by ordinary punctuation; the Qwen2.5-VL-7B per-question prediction files are gzip-compressed (*.json.gz) copies of the cleaned JSON, and sha256_original refers to the uncompressed original.
